info.cls_ename: Ph.D. Program, Department of Fiber and Composite Materials

description.describe_ch: 學生能夠以口頭發表之方式於台上報告專業論文研究，並互相討論。了解各種儀器分析設備之原理與測試方法，進而能夠應用於紡織工程之領域，提昇學生之研究水準。並參與工學院所安排專題演講，讓研究生瞭解相關產業的狀況。
description.describe_eh: Students are able to report their professional papers at the stage by way of oral presentation and discuss with each other. Understand the principles of a variety of instruments and analysis equipment and test methods, and thus can be applied in the field of textile engineering to enhance the research level of students. The seminar is arranged by Engineering College for students of Engineering College to understand the situation of the related industry.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解纖維與複合材料相關研究之發展趨勢。
targets.describe_en: Be able to realize the trend, of the related research in fiber and composite materails.

targets.describe_ch: 認知專業與道德責任的能力，具備自我要求、負責的態度。
targets.describe_en: Ability and awareness of professional and moral responsibility, self-requirements and responsible attitude.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解纖維與複合材料相關研究內容之基本原理知識及研究範疇。
targets.describe_en: Be able to realize the basic principle and scope of the related research in fiber and composite materails.

targets.describe_en: Be able to present the materials regarding the related research in fiber and composite materails.
